title: Somebody to Love
headline: 50 years ago, Queen released a high note Freddie didn't write.
caption:
Hot take: the band was right about that note, and Freddie was right to sing his own anyway.

Follow for the story behind your next favorite song.

Queen released 'Somebody to Love' 50 years ago today. They played it live from 1977 to 1985, and Freddie often changed its melodies on stage, though he'd generally still hit the sustained A♭4 notes. The studio peak on 'can anybody find me' came from his bandmates' preference, not his original line.

Tell me I'm wrong: should the record have kept Freddie's version?

🎧 The song: "Somebody to Love" by Queen (@officialqueenmusic)
